Left side: drag to walk. Right side: drag to look. Buttons: Use (sit, stand, drive), Run, Skip ⏭, Time, Camera, Menu.
Board the train through an open door. Announcements play in Bulgarian (female voice) and English (male voice) through your browser's speech engine. If the voices sound wrong, pick others under Menu → Settings.

Отиди на станция · Go to station

Real inter-station distances, 40.05 km in all. Travel times follow the distance: about 45 minutes end to end at ×1, plus dwell time. Between Жолио Кюри and Младост 1 the line runs in the open under a glass tube; after Искърско шосе it climbs out into a covered tube and onto the viaduct to the airport.

Driving: sit in the driver's seat of the leading cab. W / S move the controller between traction and brake, Space emergency brake, O opens and C closes the doors, P hands control back to the automatic driver. Stop with the front of the train at the stop board.
